name: ZAP baseline: spider + passive scan
description: Crawls the approved web application with the ZAP spider and records passive-scan findings. Passive rules do not send attack payloads. The crawl itself is web scanning activity (ATT&CK T1595.002) that a web-log monitoring rule may detect.

mapping_evidence.note: Baseline (spider + passive) execution 94d0e411 under healthy monitoring produced only 3x 31101 and 2x 31516 on agent 002: below the 31151 frequency threshold, so it was MISSED. 31151 is verified for the active scan only; for the passive baseline it stays a candidate (UNVERIFIED MAPPING).

31151.description: Multiple web server 400 error codes from same source ip.

mapping_evidence.note: ZAP baseline gap closure 2026-11-04: retest f049e6b2 of 94d0e411 collected real alerts 100401 (x2, L5) and 100402 (L10) from agent 002 within 2-8 s of the crawl start. Negative control 5076d4b8 (same scanner, robots.txt + sitemap.xml fetched, no spider) raised only telemetry 100400 (TN). Stock 31151 stays the rule for active scans.
